name: Alabama's Fall Festival and Pumpkin Patch
summary: Pumpkins, hayrides, a corn maze, rides, farm animals and food. It's a fall outing many Cullman County families look forward to.

name: Scarecrow Trail at Heritage Park
summary: Walk through creative scarecrow displays by local businesses, churches, schools and neighbors. Proceeds from exhibit registrations support the Cullman Area Literacy Council.

name: Cullman County Fair
time: Weekdays from 5:00 PM; Saturdays and Sundays from 2:00 PM; Monday Oct. 19 Kids Day from 1:00 PM
venue: Cullman County Fairgrounds, 1501 Sportsman Lake Rd NW
cost: Ride armbands and tickets sold on site; see cullmanfair.org
summary: The county fair is open through Saturday, Oct. 24, with rides, exhibits, food and family fun at the fairgrounds. The midway is cashless, so bring a card.

name: Blakgraz Live at Ethos Craft Brewing
summary: Blakgraz plays three hours of original music in a mix of styles, with giveaways during the show. Food and drinks are available.

name: Move Over MS Walk
host: North Central Neurology Associates, Joanne P. LaGanke MS Center and MS Views and News
cost: Free admission; raffle tickets $5 or five for $20
summary: Mayor Woody Jacobs proclaimed Oct. 17 Multiple Sclerosis Awareness Day in Cullman. The free walk at Heritage Park includes live music from The Overtones, free breakfast snacks, a kids costume contest and a raffle supporting local MS care.

name: Rastelli Circus
summary: The Rastelli Family Circus is in town for one day with stunts, carnival rides, live music and fair food. Bring the whole family.

name: Wallace State Volleyball: Lions Invitational vs. Illinois Central and Reid State
summary: The Wallace State Lions volleyball team plays at home in Tom Drake Coliseum. Matches move fast and are a lot of fun to watch.

name: The Big Fix Open Charity Golf Tournament
venue: Cross Creek Golf Course, 2321 County Road 490
host: Paws Up Rescue and Big Hearts Big Barks Foundation
summary: Tee it up for a good cause. This four person scramble raises money for a community spay and neuter program that helps keep healthy, adoptable dogs out of crowded shelters. Breakfast and lunch are included, and there's a silent auction, a 50/50 raffle and prizes at 1:00 PM.

name: Author Storytime and Signing with Heather Morris
venue: Arboreadum Bookshop and Garden, 104 Fourth Ave. NE
summary: Heather Morris shares her book Backyard Stew at a cozy author storytime, then stays to sign copies. A sweet Saturday afternoon stop for young readers and their families.

name: Ghost Storytime at Cullman County Public Library
venue: Cullman County Public Library, 200 Clark St NE
summary: Cayla Grace Murphy-Carnes shares a ghost story with little listeners. Free storytime is a cozy Tuesday morning treat.

name: Singo Bingo
summary: Music bingo with ice cream and prizes. Listen for the song, mark your card and enjoy a scoop.

name: For Kids' Sake Variety Show Auditions
venue: Christ Hall at St. John's Church, 512 Second Ave SE
summary: Young singers, dancers, musicians and other performers can try out for the 2027 Bownes Memorial For Kids' Sake Variety Show, which raises money for nursery and pediatric care at Cullman Regional. Can't make Tuesday? Thursday, Oct. 22, auditions are by appointment through the Foundation at 256-737-2565.

name: Storytime: Paper Shapes
venue: Shirley Burden Public Library, 201 Commercial St
summary: Little ones will hear a story all about paper shapes. It's free and a sweet way to spend a Wednesday morning.

name: Wallace State Volleyball: Calhoun
summary: The Wallace State Lions volleyball team plays at home in Tom Drake Coliseum. Matches move fast and are a lot of fun to watch.

name: Senior Day at the Cullman County Fair
venue: Cullman County Fairgrounds, 1501 Sportsman Lake Rd NW
summary: Seniors 55 and up get free admission, free parking and a free lunch for the first 400 guests. Enjoy live entertainment in the theater and stroll through all the fair exhibits. Rides will not run during Senior Day. Questions? Call the Commission on Aging at 256-734-1241.

name: Hanceville City Council Meeting
time: 6:00 PM work session, regular meeting right after
venue: Hanceville City Hall, 112 Main St SE
cost: Free and open to the public
summary: The City Council holds a work session at 6:00 PM, followed right away by its regular meeting. Residents are welcome to attend and speak during public comments. The agenda is posted on the city's website ahead of time.

name: Wallace State Volleyball: Southern Union, doubleheader
summary: The Wallace State Lions volleyball team plays at home in Tom Drake Coliseum. Matches move fast and are a lot of fun to watch.

name: Beauty and the Beast JR.
cost: Tickets online or at the door; children 3 and under free
summary: Cullman Community Theatre presents a youth production of Disney's Beauty and the Beast JR. Come cheer on the young performers.

name: Show and Tell Book Club: A Book That Haunts You
venue: Arboreadum Bookshop and Garden, 104 Fourth Ave. NE
summary: Bring the book you just can't shake, the one that still haunts you, and tell the group why. It's a fun, spooky season twist on book club, and everyone is welcome.

name: Hanceville Bulldogs Football vs. Oneonta
venue: Ray Talley Stadium, Hanceville High School
summary: A home game at Ray Talley Stadium. Come out and cheer on the Bulldogs in this region matchup.

name: Bone Yard Bash at 91 Short Track
host: Courtney Lynn Connors and Arab Blount Cullman Yardsale
summary: The second annual Bone Yard Bash has racing with cash payouts, free Hot Wheels races for kids, and pumpkin and costume contests.

name: Colony Halloween Festival
host: Colony Parks and Recreation and the Colony Volunteer Fire Department
summary: Colony Parks and Recreation and the Colony Volunteer Fire Department put on a Halloween night with a bounce house, vendors, a cake walk and more. Dress up and bring the kids.

name: Render Aid Boo Festival
venue: Randall Shedd Community Park, 605 Wesley Ave N
summary: A free family festival supporting domestic violence awareness, with a car show, live music, food trucks, hay rides, inflatables and a sensory safe area.

name: Wallace State Preview Day
venue: James C. Bailey Center, Wallace State
summary: Learn about programs and meet staff, with hayride campus tours, face painting, pumpkin painting and a bounce house. Alumni and neighbors are welcome, too.

name: Cullman Therapeutic Recreation Halloween Party
venue: Palomino RV Resort at Burrow Hamilton Farm, 1315 County Road 222
summary: Spooky fun for everyone! Come in costume for candy, a costume contest and hot dogs grilled by Cullman police officers. Therapeutic Recreation members get a special closed trick or treat, and the resort is fully accessible. Please RSVP by Monday, Oct. 19, using the contact in the source article.

name: Spooktacular Storybook 5K and 1 Mile Fun Run
venue: Cullman County Public Library, 200 Clark St NE
host: Friends of the Public Libraries of Cullman County
summary: Dress as your favorite book character and run or walk a new course that starts and ends at the library. There are awards for the fastest runners, age groups and best costume, and the race kicks off the library's capital campaign. Register at storybook5k.com.

name: Trick or Treat with the Chamber
venue: Cullman Area Chamber of Commerce, 301 Second Ave SW
summary: Pick up a free trick or treat bag and a list of stops at the Chamber on Friday, Oct. 23, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. On Saturday, take the kids around to the participating Cullman businesses for treats. Bags are first come, first served.

name: Murder at Jubilee Manor: Murder Mystery Dinner
summary: Dinner and a mystery to solve. Ticket and menu details have not been posted yet, so check the event page for updates.

name: Hanceville Planning Commission Meeting
cost: Free and open to the public
summary: The Planning Commission meets about zoning, land subdivision and development plans in the city. Anyone may attend.

name: Halloween Storytime at Cullman County Public Library
venue: Cullman County Public Library, 200 Clark St NE
summary: Amber Thornton reads Alice and Greta and Here a Creek, There a Shriek for a spooky free morning at the library.

name: WildWater Trunk or Treat
summary: Trunk or treat returns at WildWater with candy and music. Bring costumes and the kids for an easy Halloween stop.

name: Halloween Storytime and STEM Fun
venue: Shirley Burden Public Library, 201 Commercial St
summary: Halloween stories plus a science worksheet with a spooky theme. Free for families.

name: West Point Trunk or Treat
summary: The Town of West Point hosts trunk or treat with candy, games, food trucks and costumes. A fun midweek Halloween stop for families.

name: Sourdough Class with Anett at Mavens and Makers
venue: Mavens and Makers, 302 Second Ave SE
host: Mavens and Makers with Danube Delights Bakery
summary: Learn to bake crusty homemade sourdough in a two hour class made for beginners. Every baker goes home with a live starter, and light refreshments are included. Reserve a spot at mavensandmakers.setmore.com or call 256-297-1097.

name: Southern Pie Class: Sweet Pie with a Lattice Top
venue: North Alabama Agriplex, 1714 Tally Ho St SW
summary: Learn to make a tender, flaky pie crust from scratch, fill it with a classic Southern sweet filling and weave a full lattice top. Youth ages 12 to 15 need to register with a paid adult.

name: Hanceville Bulldogs Football at Elkmont
summary: The Bulldogs travel to Elkmont for the last game of the regular season.

name: Sawdust Jukebox Live at Goat Island Brewing
summary: Sawdust Jukebox plays a four hour Friday night set of classic and 90s country. Bring your boots.

name: Uganda Spaghetti Fundraiser
cost: $12 per plate; buy tickets by Oct 28
summary: Eat in or take out a spaghetti dinner. The money raised supports the church's 2027 medical mission trip to Uganda.

name: Camp-O-Ween at Smith Lake Park
summary: Food trucks, games, contests, rides, a DJ and campground trick or treating make Halloween at Smith Lake Park a full day outing.

name: Drive Through Trick or Treat
summary: For the sixth year, Hanceville firefighters and EMTs are handing out candy to kids who stay in the car. Costumes are encouraged, and seatbelts are required.

name: Nightmare on Woodland Street
summary: Families along Woodland Street NW team up every Halloween with interactive props, plenty of candy and a whole street full of spooky fun.

name: Berlin Trunk or Treat
venue: Berlin Farmers Market, 50 Mt. Carmel Drive
summary: Full size candy bars from the Town of Berlin and free bounce houses for the kids. Businesses, churches and groups are welcome to set up a trunk, and candy donations can be dropped off at Berlin Town Hall.

name: Events and Community Development Committee Meeting
venue: Shirley Burden Public Library, 201 Commercial St
cost: Free and open to the public
summary: The city's events committee plans community events and works on tourism and local partnerships. Residents with ideas are welcome to come.

name: Wallace State Men's Basketball vs. Snead State
summary: The Lions play Snead State. Check the official schedule for the location and any time changes before you go.

name: 16th Annual Mud Creek Arts and Crafts Festival
summary: Downtown turns into a big street fair with craft vendors, food, kids activities and music. Proceeds go to Hanceville schools and the city.

name: Cullman Veterans Day Celebration
summary: Warbirds, skydivers, military flyovers, living history and special guest Mike Durant, all to honor our veterans. The celebration goes on rain or shine.

name: Wallace State Men's Basketball vs. Itawamba
summary: The Lions play Itawamba. Check the official schedule for the location and any time changes before you go.

name: Cipollari Live: A Fundraiser for the Randy Travis Foundation
venue: Terri Pines Country Club, 700 Pine Hill Dr
summary: Hanceville's own Cipollari, a bluegrass band of six siblings, plays a free benefit concert for the Randy Travis Foundation, which supports arts and music for kids. Grab free tickets through the link in the source article.

name: Holly Pond Lions Club Pancake Breakfast
venue: Holly Pond Lions Club Building, Lyons Park Road
summary: Pancakes, bacon, sausage and coffee or juice, to eat in or take out. Proceeds help the Lions Club project fund and the food pantry between Town Hall and the fire department.

name: Hanceville City Council Meeting
time: 6:00 PM work session, regular meeting right after
venue: Hanceville City Hall, 112 Main St SE
cost: Free and open to the public
summary: The City Council holds a work session at 6:00 PM, followed right away by its regular meeting. The city announced this date on its Oct. 8 agenda.

name: United Way Designer Bag Bingo
summary: An evening of bingo with designer handbag prizes. Proceeds support local needs and programs through United Way of Cullman County.

name: Cullman Christmas Open House
host: Cullman Area Chamber of Commerce and Visitor Center
summary: Holiday shopping kicks off with store specials, a cookie crawl, visits with Santa and a window display contest.

summary: This year's class of inductees will be honored at a dinner and ceremony. The event was moved to this new date, and ticket details are coming soon.

name: Run Run Rudolph at Winter Wonderland
venue: Sportsman Lake Park, 1544 Sportsman Lake Rd NW
summary: Run or stroll through the Winter Wonderland Christmas lights on foot, one night only. Registration opens at 4:00 PM, runners start at 5:00 PM and walkers follow. There's an ugly sweater and Christmas costume contest, dogs and strollers are welcome, and kids 6 and under are free. Park at the fairgrounds.
